That charger is the UGREEN Nexode Air 65W, confirmed by Charge-Test and techtest.org on the current version only. ChatGPT's card showed it at $53.99 on Newegg. standout_why: I compared against Apple Support 102574, Charge-Test's iPhone 18 Pro Max test, both ChargerLAB reviews (Pro and Pro Max), iThinkDiff's Oct 30 list (updated Nov 26) and BGR. LTT Labs returned 403, so I could not read it. iThinkDiff prices every charger ($22.79 for the Nexode Air 65W, no seller named) but only repeats makers' AVS claims and cites no tests. Charge-Test and techtest.org test which chargers negotiate AVS but give no prices. Charge-Test, which ChatGPT cited in one chat, already says the 'X774' 160W fails AVS, so that part is not new. ChargerLAB's tested chargers are mostly Chinese-market models (CUKTECH, CANDYSIGN, Rewoda). The new part is putting a tested AVS result next to the maker-store price read today, plus the warning that our five-port 160W is the X774.
decides: This confirms the map's pick. The Apple 40W Dynamic adapter is the one Apple names (51.23 W on SPR AVS in ChargerLAB's Pro Max test). The UGREEN Nexode Air 65W is the cheapest charger a named tester confirmed, at {price:ugreen-nexode-air-65w-gan-charger} on UGREEN's US store, but buyers must get the current version: our record says Charge-Test found no AVS on its 'Version 1' unit. Our ugreen-nexode-pro-160w-5-port must not appear as an AVS row. It matches the X774 (140 W on C1/C2), which techtest.org found falls back to about 45 W. Name it once as the 'does it have it' trap. One conflict: ChargerLAB's table shows an unnamed 'UGREEN 160W Charger' reaching 52.04 W on SPR AVS, so the model number decides. The ESR Xtend 45W stays on maker claims only, because none of ChargerLAB, Charge-Test or techtest.org lists it. That keeps it out of the top three under the research notes. The Baseus AH22 has AVS in our record, but techtest.org has only a reader comment warning that it does not hold the load steady. The Belkin WCH022's AVS is disputed (BGR says yes, iThinkDiff says PPS only).
